description:
As a user with more than one agent available
  I want switching the active agent to actually change who answers
  So that agent selection isn't just cosmetic

elements.name: Switching agent changes the answering agent

steps.name: two agents "BDD Agent Aurora" (model "openai/gpt-5.4-mini") and "BDD Agent Borealis" (model "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku") exist
a fresh conversation using "BDD Agent Aurora"
I send the message "Which agent is answering?"
the assistant responds with content containing "Agent Aurora"
I switch the active agent to "BDD Agent Borealis"
I send the message "Which agent is answering?"
the assistant responds with content containing "Agent Borealis"

name: Chat with agent selection and mid-session switching

description:
As a user with a knowledge base attached to my agent
  I want retrieved document content to actually reach the LLM call
  So that answers are grounded in my ingested documents, not generic

steps.name: I have ingested a knowledge base document containing "The secret onboarding code is ZEBRA-42."
a fresh conversation with an agent scoped to that knowledge base
I ask "What is the secret onboarding code mentioned in the handbook?"
the assistant responds with content containing "ZEBRA-42"
the outgoing request's system prompt actually contains "The secret onboarding code is ZEBRA-42."

description:
As a user configuring which agent (and therefore which provider/model) answers
  I want the outgoing LLM request's model field to actually change
  So that provider/model configuration is a real routing decision, not just display state

elements.name: Model configuration changes the answering model

steps.name: two agents "BDD Agent Aurora" (model "openai/gpt-5.4-mini") and "BDD Agent Borealis" (model "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku") exist
a fresh conversation using "BDD Agent Aurora"
I send the message "Which agent is answering?"
the outgoing request's model field is "gpt-5.4-mini"
I switch the active agent to "BDD Agent Borealis"
I send the message "Which agent is answering?"
the outgoing request's model field is "claude-5-haiku"

name: Chat with provider/model configuration affecting the answering model

description:
As a user with no knowledge base configured for my agent
  I want a plain chat response with no retrieval-related UI
  So that I can trust the chat works standalone, without requiring a KB

elements.name: Plain chat with no knowledge base

steps.name: a fresh conversation with an agent that has no knowledge bases attached
I send the message "What is 2 plus 2?"
the assistant responds with content containing "2 plus 2 is 4"
no knowledge-base retrieval indicator is shown in the transcript

name: Chat with no knowledge base attached

description:
As a user whose message matches a configured skill's trigger
  I want the frontend to visibly show which skill activated
  So that I can trust the system is actually applying the skill, not just replying generically

steps.name: a fresh conversation with an agent bound to a skill triggered by the keyword "diagnostics"
I send the message "Please run diagnostics on the system."
the assistant responds with content containing "Diagnostics complete"
a skill-activation indicator for "BDD Diagnostics Skill" is shown in the transcript

name: Chat with a skill activated mid-conversation

description:
As a user whose message triggers a tool call
  I want to see both the tool invocation and its result in the transcript
  So that I can trust the agent actually used a tool, not just described using one

elements.name: Tool call invoked and result surfaced

steps.name: a fresh conversation with an agent that has tools enabled
I send the message "Echo this via the bdd tool-call scenario."
a tool-call block for "native_echo" is shown in the transcript
the tool-call result contains "echoed via the tool loop"

name: Chat with a tool call, invocation and result surfaced in the transcript
